QUOTE: The `NetworkManager` default config sets `retryPolicyConfiguration` to `EXPONENTIAL_RETRY`, `retryLimit: 3`, base 2, scale 0.5 (`app/managers/network_manager.ts:68-73`). ... Tracking requests override this to `retryLimit: 0` ... Nothing in the post send path does.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: It states the default exponential retry limit of 3 in the network manager, but says nothing in the post path opts out. It claims the opposite, and it explicitly leaves open whether POST is retried.
